scoring_justification: Recomputing the tight-binding model in the verifier is infeasible; comparing the agent's reported frequencies and masses to the paper's reference values (Table I) is the strongest feasible tier.

outputs.description: Computed dHvA frequencies and band cyclotron masses for the selected cyclotron orbits. The values will be compared against independent reference data within prescribed tolerances (not disclosed here).

output_contract.notes: Orbit labels must match exactly: α, β (two orientations distinguished by angle in the pipeline but the contracted CSV contains one row per orbit; if more than one orientation is present, additional rows should be clearly labelled). The checker expects one row for each of the six named orbits. The solving agent must ensure the tight-binding model and Fermi surface extraction are carried out before computing these quantities.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference dHvA frequencies and masses from the paper's Table I (F_cal and m_b_cal columns).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I, calculated values for F_cal and m_b_cal.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed directly from the published Table I.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported calculated values, used as hidden gold for result comparison.
